notes:
How to use: 1) Sort by Opportunity Score then Probability to prioritize weekly scrub. 2) Opportunity Score = weighted sum: usage delta (35%), ARR (20%), exec engagement (25%), risk signals (20%). 3) Probability bands: >=80% (Green), 50-79% (Watch), 25-49% (At-risk), <25% (High risk).
Coloring rules: green band rows for prob>=80, amber for 50-79, red for <50.
Key actions: attach last 90-day usage chart and top 3 support tickets to each row prior to QBR.
Owner responsibilities: update 'Last Contact' after any outreach and set 'Next Step' within 3 business days after scrub.
scoring_legend: Usage delta: 30d pct change vs baseline (-50 to +100 -> scaled 0-40)
Exec engagement: None -> 0, Low -> 10, Medium -> 20, High -> 40
Risk signals: each negative signal -10 (security incident, product outage, legal hold)
next_steps_template: Immediate (0-7 days): Technical triage / executive outreach / legal checklist
Short (7-21 days): Pricing proposal / PO guidance / expansion package
Medium (21-45 days): Migration plan / capacity estimate / pilot ROI
Long (>45 days): Renewal contingency planning / contract exit assistance
